entities.name: Query FtsH protease
observations: The supplied sequence is 652 amino acids long and has an estimated molecular mass of 71.5 kDa, theoretical pI 5.81, and mildly negative predicted charge at pH 7.
Two strong hydrophobic segments occur near residues 18–37 and 113–142, consistent with the two N-terminal transmembrane helices of bacterial FtsH.
The sequence contains a Walker A/P-loop-like ATPase motif MVGNPGCGKTLL around residue 212.
The sequence contains an HEXXH-like zinc metalloprotease motif HESGH around residue 417 and an NPDV motif near residue 294, supporting FtsH protease architecture.
Closest reviewed homologs are FtsH proteins Q1LLA9, P63344, and P63343, with 60.9–62.3% identity and 92.8–95.4% query coverage.
Homolog annotations support ATP-dependent zinc metalloprotease activity, inner-membrane localization, cytoplasmic catalytic domain, and homohexameric assembly.

entities.name: FtsH homolog Q1LLA9
observations: Reviewed Cupriavidus metallidurans FtsH homolog; 62.3% identity and 92.8% query coverage to the query sequence.
Annotated as an ATP-dependent zinc metallopeptidase involved in cytoplasmic and membrane protein quality control; binds one Zn2+ per subunit and forms a homohexamer.

entities.name: FtsH homolog P63344
observations: Reviewed Salmonella typhi FtsH homolog; 60.9% identity and 95.4% query coverage to the query sequence.
Annotated as an inner-membrane ATP-dependent zinc metalloprotease with homohexameric assembly.

entities.name: FtsH Zn2+ cofactor
observations: Reviewed FtsH homologs are annotated to bind one Zn2+ ion per subunit for metalloprotease activity.

entities.name: Bacterial membrane protein quality control
observations: FtsH homolog annotations associate the protein with proteolysis and quality control of integral membrane proteins.
